# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| Agents | IterativeTDDRunner | Drives Kent Beck-style RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop until planner declares COMPLETE |
| Agents | TDDCycleRunner | Executes one complete TDD cycle with GREEN retries and optional learning loop |
| Agents | IncrementalPlanner | Determines the next test increment via LLM given current test and implementation state |
| Agents | PythonLanguagePod | LanguagePod for Python: generates code via WorkerAgent and executes in PodmanOrchestrator |
| Agents | TypeScriptLanguagePod | LanguagePod for TypeScript: generates code via TypeScriptWorkerAgent and executes in PodmanOrchestrator |
| Agents | GoLanguagePod | LanguagePod for Go: generates code and runs tests using Go toolchain |
| Agents | WorkerAgent | Generates code for RED, GREEN, REFACTOR phases using LLM with playbook context |
| Agents | TypeScriptWorkerAgent | TypeScript-specific code generation for TDD phases |
| Agents | PodmanOrchestrator | Stateless sidecar execution layer that sends pulse (files) to container and checks security |
| Agents | PodmanRunner | Rootless Podman container runner that executes tests and returns results |
| Agents | TypeScriptRunner | PodmanRunner variant preconfigured for TypeScript harness image |
| Agents | AutonomousTDDAgent | Legacy agent that builds features incrementally using ensemble learning |
| Agents | GherkinFeatureBridge | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec for TDD cycle input |
| Agents | GherkinExtractionAgent | Reverse-engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |
| Agents | RedundancyPreChecker | Detects redundant tests before writing them in RED phase |
| Agents | TestReviewAgent | Validates test quality before implementation |
| Agents | TDDFailureRecorder | Records failures and interventions for self-healing |
| Agents | TDDLessonInjector | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts based on phase |
| Agents | ReactorModule (Reflector) | Analyzes generator performance and extracts insights (error, root cause, correct approach) |
| Agents | CuratorModule | Synthesizes insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Agents | GeneratorModule | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM with bullet retrieval |
| Agents | PolyglotTDDRunner | Drives RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple LanguagePods and compares token efficiency |
| Agents | ProjectArchitecture | Caches project folder structure for intelligent file placement |
| Agents | CodeReuseDetector | Detects opportunities for code reuse within the project |
| Core | PlaybookManager | Manages playbook creation, delta updates, semantic deduplication, and token budget |
| Core | ExperimentLogger | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| Core | EnsembleLearner | Orchestrates multiple models learning in parallel with cross-voting and deliberation |
| Core | ConsensusBuilder | Builds consensus from multiple model proposals via clustering |
| Core | VotingSystem | Applies voting strategies (majority, weighted, escalating) to approve/reject bullets |
| Core | ContextGraphRetriever (CGR³) | Context-aware retrieve-rank-reason pipeline for bullet selection |
| Core | BulletRetriever | Hybrid retrieval system for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| Core | PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN success rate |
| Core | TDDCycleAnalyzer | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trend over time |
| Core | SuccessRateCalculator | Measures experiment success rates across the system |
| Core | TokenEfficiencyReporter | Aggregates token usage data and computes efficiency scores |
| Core | BlindEvaluator | Scores outputs without knowing which agent produced them |
| Core | ProductionDataAnalyzer | Analyzes experiment_logs to extract model performance metrics |
| Broker | AdaptiveBroker | Routes tasks to best agent based on learned performance (cost-aware, Pareto) |
| Broker | PerformanceAggregator | Extracts metrics from audit trail for agent performance evaluation |
| Broker | CapabilityRegistry | Tracks anonymous agent capabilities and proficiency |
| Broker | RegressionDetector | Detects quality regressions across model versions using CUSUM |
| Broker | FeedbackCollector | Stores human ratings and calculates blended scores and drift |
| Storage | PlaybookRepository | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for semantic search on bullets |
| Storage | AuditStore | Append-only audit event store with SHA-256 hash chain integrity |
| Storage | AuditClient | Write-only audit client for ACE agents |
| Contract | ContractArchitect | Generates interface contracts from natural language requirements |
| Contract | ContractDecomposer | Breaks user specs into interface contracts |
| Contract | ContractValidator | Validates implementations against contract test cases |
| Contract | ModuleArchitect | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems |
| Contract | ModuleTDDBuilder | Builds module implementations using TDD for each function |
| Playbook | BulletClusterer | DBSCAN-based clustering for playbook bullets |
| Playbook | BulletDeduplicator | Semantic deduplication using embedding similarity |
| Playbook | DistillationRouter | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks with provenance checking |
| Playbook | PlaybookQA | Answers coding questions using playbook knowledge |
| Playbook | MarkdownImporter | Imports knowledge from markdown files into playbook bullets |
| ML | MLflowKnowledgeQuery | Unified query interface for MLflow runs enriched with ACE knowledge |
| ML | ACEMLflowCallback | MLflow callback for automatic ACE knowledge capture during training |
| ML | PostgresACEMLflowCallback | PostgreSQL-backed MLflow callback that stores knowledge in experiment_logs |
| Utility | LLMClient | Unified LLM client supporting OpenRouter, Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, vLLM, etc. |
| Utility | EmbeddingService | Local embedding generation using sentence-transformers |
| Utility | ContextMap | Builds and queries AST signatures for module context in prompts |
| Utility | ImportFilter | Checks generated code for forbidden imports and blocked builtins |
| Utility | ImportValidator | Validates and corrects import paths in generated code |
| Utility | EffGenAdapter | Adapter for integrating small language models (effGen) with Capability Broker |
| Utility | ClaudeCliClient | LLM client backed by local `claude -p` CLI |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestr as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Reflect as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    Runner ->> Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number)
    Planner -->> Runner: PodSpec (feature, test_file, impl_file)

    loop per cycle
        Runner ->> Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Note over Cycle,Pod: --- RED phase ---
        Cycle ->> Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod ->> Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker -->> Pod: test_code
        Pod ->> Orchestr: pulse({test_file: code})
        activate Orchestr
        Orchestr ->> Container: send_pulse(files)
        Container -->> Orchestr: PulseResult
        deactivate Orchestr
        Orchestr -->> Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Pod
        Pod -->> Cycle: red_result

        alt red_result passed or security abort
            Note over Cycle: Abort cycle, log failure
            Cycle ->> Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
            Cycle -->> Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
        else RED passed (test failed as expected)
            Note over Cycle,Pod: --- GREEN phase (with retries) ---
            loop max_green_attempts times
                Cycle ->> Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
                activate Pod
                Pod ->> Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
                Worker -->> Pod: impl_code
                Pod ->> Orchestr: pulse({test: code, impl: code})
                activate Orchestr
                Orchestr ->> Container: send_pulse(files)
                Container -->> Orchestr: PulseResult
                deactivate Orchestr
                Orchestr -->> Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Pod
                Pod -->> Cycle: green_result
                alt green_result.passed
                    break (Note: GREEN succeeded)
                else not passed
                    alt security abort
                        Note over Cycle: Abort due to SecurityBreach/ForbiddenImport
                        Cycle ->> Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                        Cycle -->> Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
                        deactivate Cycle
                        exit loop
                    else
                        Note over Cycle: Retry with error feedback
                        Cycle ->> Pod: send feedback
                    end
                end
            end
            alt green_result passed
                Note over Cycle,Pod: --- REFACTOR phase ---
                Cycle ->> Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod ->> Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
                Worker -->> Pod: code
                Pod ->> Orchestr: pulse({test: code, impl: code})
                activate Orchestr
                Orchestr ->> Container: send_pulse(files)
                Container -->> Orchestr: PulseResult
                deactivate Orchestr
                Orchestr -->> Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Pod
                Pod -->> Cycle: refactor_result

                Note over Cycle,Playbook: --- Learning loop (optional) ---
                alt reflector and curator present
                    Cycle ->> Reflect: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                    Reflect -->> Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    Cycle ->> Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                    Curator -->> Cycle: CuratorOutput (delta_bullets)
                    Cycle ->> Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                end

                Cycle ->> Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                Cycle -->> Runner: CycleResult(success=true)
            else
                Cycle ->> Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                Cycle -->> Runner: CycleResult(success=false)
            end
        end
        deactivate Cycle
    end

    Runner ->> Logger: log cycle summary
    Note over Runner: Continue until planner declares COMPLETE or max iterations reached
```
